meta.name: home_refused_at_a_safe_height_of_zero
meta.description: With zAxisSafeHeight 0 or less, Home and Return to Center would travel with the bit at or below the work surface, so each is refused with an alert naming the setting and its value, and nothing is written. Python sent G00 Z0.0 and travelled.

alerts.message: Set the Z-axis safe height (Maslow Settings, zAxisSafeHeight) to a number above 0 before returning to home, so the bit rises before it moves. It holds "0".
to a number above 0 before returning to center

events.comment: nothing is written: no G90, no raise, no travel
